params.name: Layout
params.note: The layout document as a JSON string (round-tripped by the same validation as the JavaScript side); leave it null for the default arrangement. The bound value is the JSON of the new layout.

params.name: ChildContent
params.note: The panels: children with slot="<panel id>", so the slot is not a fixed one (the element slots each panel by its own id). slot="empty" and slot="toolbar-start" are reserved (the empty state, and a host app's own top-level toolbar menus) and are never treated as a panel.

notes: Hand-written (issue #592): controlled mode. confirmLayout(arg) is a callback property (business logic, not config data, set from script the same way pk-tool-page's run is), so the component hands it a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) built from the ConfirmLayout parameter. Not set, the element is free-running (unchanged from PR #540): a resize or tab change applies right away and then fires pk-layout-change. ConfirmLayout set, every change holds until it resolves with the confirmed layout json (or null to keep the previous one); a rejection also keeps the previous layout. Not a mapped param: the generator only maps props, slots and events.
